title: Wso2am: Netty is a network application framework for development of protocol servers and clients (CVE-2026-48043)
description: A high-severity security vulnerability (CVE-2026-48043) affects the wso2am package, specifically related to the Netty network application framework used for protocol server and client development. The vulnerability impacts availability but does not affect confidentiality or integrity. Fixed versions 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4 address this issue.
